purpose: Teach: 年長/憤り/カンタン/逝っ/ねらっ/まっか/他界/対極

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、年長の先輩に敬語使えるな
lines.en: You know, Riku — you actually use polite language with your seniors.
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Quick cadence like she's caught him in something small and kind. Warm amusement underneath, no edge. Leans on the word 'actually' with gentle surprise.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、いじめに憤り感じてたな、桜
lines.en: And you — you really felt how wrong that bullying was, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Slow, measured. Turning her own teasing back on her with care — not mockery, but recognition. Soft completion at the end, like he's seen her clearly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、宿題はカンタンに終わったろ?
lines.en: Come on, Riku — you breezed through that homework assignment, didn't you.
lines.style: Dry half-smile in the voice. Knowing cadence. She's calling him out without pressure — almost playful. The tone says 'I know you better than you think.'

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お祖母様が逝ってしまわれて辛かったろ、桜
lines.en: You — losing your grandmother like that must have hurt, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft opening. The words slow down and deepen. No rush. He's holding the weight of what he's saying. Gentle but not fragile — the tenderness of someone who knows silence matters too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、優勝をねらって練習してたな
lines.en: You were aiming for the championship the whole time you were training, Riku.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Simple statement of fact — she's witnessed something genuine in him. No performance, just recognition. Slight warmth on his name at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、告白して顔がまっかになってたな、桜
lines.en: And you — you confessed and turned completely red, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, small smile. Teasing but not cruel — the tone of someone who saw him vulnerable and is choosing to be kind about it. Quick rhythm, light touch.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、芸能人が他界されたニュースで泣いてたな
lines.en: You cried when you heard that celebrity had passed away, Riku.
lines.style: Simple, direct statement. No judgment. Just observation held with care. Slight pause before his name — acknowledging something real he didn't try to hide.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お父さんとは対極の性格だって言われてたな、桜
lines.en: And people told you that you're nothing like your dad, didn't they, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry close. Dry undertone. Quick, knowing. The kind of comment that catches her in how people have misread them both. Slight irony at the edges — he understands more than she thinks.
